reader.requirement: READ ... INTO must do the READ and then, only if it succeeded, MOVE the current record (its RECORD-clause size; a group move under RECORD IS VARYING) to identifier-1 under MOVE rules, with identifier-1's subscripts evaluated after the record is read; the record stays in the record area too.

edition-consulted.switches: IntoPhraseRules.PhraseAt(DialectLevel, organization) picks the edition's MoveRule citation/wording for the implicit MOVE's diagnostics; the move itself (BoundCurrentRecord vs BoundFieldOperand) is chosen by file.Varying alone
the compiling program's edition baked on the connector, read by every DialectBehaviors.IsActive in the connector

reader.edition-search: read KeyedIoBinder.BindRead, KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRead and the IndexedConnector READ members; grep DialectBehaviors.IsActive|Edition|Year|DialectLevel over those files and the StatementValidation READ checks; BindIntoPhrase picks BoundCurrentRecord (VARYING) or BoundFieldOperand (fixed) from file.Varying alone
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (only the diagnostic wording of the implicit MOVE's descriptor follows the dialect level)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_f16_06; not covered: an elementary record into a numeric or edited receiver, a failed READ, subscripts set by the READ, RECORD IS VARYING with ODO, RECORD CONTAINS 4 TO 8 with two record descriptions

probes.expected: MOVE rules: alphanumeric into numeric and edited, not a group move
no implied MOVE after an unsuccessful READ; the DEPENDING item unchanged

probes.printed: H2=00 [A1A---B3C------] (INTO WT(H-SUB), H-SUB in the record: 1 then 3)
probes.expected: the subscript evaluated after each record is read

probes.printed: V1=00 [011A    ] 04 V2=00 [023BCD  ] 06 V3=00 [011A  ] 04 (VARYING with ODO, into X(8) and into 9(6))
probes.expected: group move of the current record (4 or 6 characters), space-filled, also into a numeric receiver
the shorter record carries no stale tail from the longer one

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR8  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR8

reader.notes: BindIntoPhrase binds the implicit MOVE from the record area (BoundCurrentRecord for VARYING: a group move of the read length); ResolveReceivingAtStore defers subscripts to the store; EmitRead runs the move only under Successful(status).

refuter.evidence: q4into-004 at --std 85. Reference modification by a value the READ sets is evaluated after the read: M1 put the record at the read H-POS (5). A group record into S9(7) SIGN LEADING SEPARATE is a group move with no conversion: M2 bytes [12345   ]. A receiving group with ODO whose object it receives uses the maximum length (VI.5.8.4 GR3b): WG-T(4)='w', WG-T(5) and WG-T(9) spaces. q1keyref-002: G1 is a group record into 9(6), [01AAu1]. On a status 02 READ the INTO move happens (I1). q4into-001: INTO with a second, numeric 01 is refused by GR7 (COBOL1994). --std 2023 printed the same (q4into-003). cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR8; OK §1985:VI.5.8.4 GR3b.
